description: State Ministry of Production, Supply & Regulation of Pharmaceuticals - The National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act No. 5 of 2015 - The Medical of Devices Pricing Regulations No. 01 of 2017 - Amended - The Medical of Devices Pricing Regulations No. 05 of 2017 - Amended - The Medical of Devices Pricing Regulations 2018 - Amended - The Medical (Pricing of Medical Devises) Regulations No. 01 of 2021 - Amended
reasoning: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No. 5 of 2015. It specifically amends the Medical Devices Pricing Regulations, establishing maximum retail prices for medical devices and setting compliance requirements for manufacturers, importers, and distributors. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing regulations under statutory authority.
